text: The meeting identified a hardware/display problem as the presenter reports the screen is missing.
Participants report being slow and under-prepared for the kickoff, indicating preparation/co-ordination gaps.
Unclear scope was raised, with uncertainty about which animal to draw and which design components to include.

The team outlined action-oriented items: the Project Manager will summarize the discussed items and defend the design; the Industrial Designer will create an overview for the three design phases and work on the conceptual design; and the Marketing Expert will conduct internet searches and user interviews to determine user requirements.
